context.content: I'm a mid level ironman, sitting at 386 quest points (I got my quest cape just a couple of days ago!). My stats are mediocre, sitting at level 114 with 80 in most of my combat stats. Despite what you may think about Runescapes typical player base, I like to think this sort of level if pretty representative of the norm. The jump in difficulty regarding the fight(s) at the end of the maze is absolutely ridiculous, there's absolutely no way I'm going to be able to finish this quest. There's maxed players I know of that have struggled to complete the final fight with T90s, who the hell thought that this quest was applicable for Combat 115? Was this fight play tested on an account that was actually level 115? Please rethink the difficult of the end of quest fight, we're really not all PVM'ers, and this difficulty sky rockets any previous quest difficulty - I know, because before today I had my cape to prove it.
